source: ABCD agent guidelines (Chen et al. 2021, arXiv 2104.00783), data/guidelines.json

rules.statement: The agent is permitted to complete the purchase on the customer's behalf via Make Purchase only after collecting the credit card number, expiration date, and the brand/item phrase.
Escalation to the Website Team via Notify Internal Team requires entering 'website team' as the value, and is required to occur only after the basic troubleshooting steps have been offered.
For search or site-speed issues, the agent is required to first attempt Log Out/In or Try Again prior to escalating to the Website Team.
